general.summary: On 12 November 2026, the Cloud Software Group published security bulletins for its Citrix products addressing 28 memory flaws in Citrix NetScaler ADC and Citrix NetScaler Gateway. One of these vulnerabilities, CVE-2026-120868, affects every deployment, including those using the default configuration. The vendor bulletin describes the impact as unpredictable behaviour and denial of service. Citrix reports no exploitation, and no public proof-of-concept has been confirmed. CERT-EU strongly recommends upgrading all customer-managed NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway appliances to the fixed releases. Internet-facing Gateway and AAA appliances should be upgraded first.
general.title: 2026-020: Critical Vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway
